task.title: "Always Open With.."
task.body:
According to the latest update "qRemote now registers as an "Open In" handler for .torrent files — open a torrent file from another app to add it directly"

What does that mean exactly? In my Files app, I can see that my torrent has the qRemote icon on it, but tapping doesn't take me to qRemote. It just tries to show it via Preview. If I tap "Get Info" on the .torrent, it says "No Apps Available" next to "Always Open With".  I can share the .torrent to qRemote but I feel like it should be simpler than that? Or am I doing something wrong? 

Thanks.
